# Config: Battery

> **Reader:** `BatteryConfig` (`config/BatteryConfig.qml`)
> **Schema:** `config/json/config.schema.json` → `properties.Battery` · category General

Battery: Low and critical battery levels, on laptops: the Battery widget takes its low and critical colors at them, and a notification says when the battery drops to one.

Each setting: `path` · type = default · enum/range/unit; then title: description; annotations; `read:` the reader member(s) (exact unless marked) and `in:` the files that use them.
